'''N-4PO''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], that operated during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
N-4PO lived in the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] colony in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[X2-4]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Uffel]], where he worked as the administrator of [[Uffel Research and Development]]. In c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], he encountered the [[Heroes of Cularin]] when they visited Uffel, and assigned the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R6-D6]] to deal with any queries that they had.<ref name="SU" />

During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Thaereian military]] activated defense protocols in some of the droids of Uffel, making them want to fight against organic beings to keep the droids of Uffel safe, and N-4PO became one of the leaders of the rogue droids. Shortlty afterward, encountered the Heroes of Cularin for a second time, when they traveled to Uffel to investigate the Thaereian activities on the moon.<ref name="UP">{{LivingForce|Inside-out: Uffel's Prisoners}}</ref>
